llm.summary: This skill appears intended for read-only VMware log queries, but it also documents automatic local credential-file rewriting and persistent audit logging despite repeated zero-write claims.

dimensions.detail: Network access to the configured Log Insight appliance, local config, and credential environment variables are proportionate for this integration, but users should expect access to potentially sensitive operational log data.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Installation is via a uv package with normal setup steps for config and credentials; the artifact does not describe unusual install-time execution beyond installing the tool and creating configuration files.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The main instructions repeatedly describe the skill as strictly read-only with zero write surface, while later sections disclose local writes to an audit database and automatic rewriting of plaintext password values in the .env file.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill documents persistent audit records at ~/.vmware/audit.db and automatic mutation of ~/.vmware-log-insight/.env credential material on first load; these behaviors are disclosed but undercut the stronger no-write framing.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The advertised VMware Log Insight capabilities are coherent and limited to reading log events, aggregations, metadata, and alert information from a configured appliance.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review before installing. Use a least-privilege read-only Log Insight account, avoid storing real secrets in the .env file if your policy forbids local credential rewriting, and confirm whether persistent audit records in ~/.vmware/audit.db are acceptable for your environment.
llm.findings:
[SDI-4] unexpected: The artifact supports this concern: password values in the local .env file are documented as automatically rewritten to b64 form on first load, which is a credential-file mutation despite broad read-only claims.
[SDI-1] unexpected: The artifact supports a documentation mismatch: the manifest and overview say the skill never writes, while the audit and setup documentation disclose local .env rewriting.
[RA2] expected: Audit logging is coherent for administrative VMware tooling and is disclosed, but the persistent shared audit database is not fully scoped in the top-level safety claims or retention details.
